newsitem.title: USA: E.W. Blanch to take $22.8 mln Q4 charge.
newsitem.headline: E.W. Blanch to take $22.8 mln Q4 charge.

text.p: E.W. Blanch Holdings Inc said on Monday it would take a fourth-quarter charge of $22.8 million to reflect the restructuring of its San Antonio, Texas-based managing general agency operations.
It said the charge, which includes a $19.5 million writedown of goodwill associated with the 1994 acquisition of the Elton George Cos, will reduce fourth-quarter earnings by $1.05 per share.
The restructuring charge includes a $3.25 million reserve for restructuring the San Antonio operation and its related lease expenses.
First Call's fourth quarter mean estimate for E.W. Blanch was for earnings of $0.37 per share, up from $0.21 a share a year earlier.

"The decision to write down the goodwill and take the restructuring reserve was made after careful analysis of the operations and future potential of the managing general agency," said Chairman Edgar Blanch Jr.
The company provides integrated risk management and distribution services.
